component.name: ModelControlFlow
component.summary: Measure open-weights models on this machine

description.p: MCF acquires models with their provenance intact, serves them as a local endpoint, puts them on a bench of diagnostic laboratories, measures what they cost and what they are worth on this hardware, and writes every result to an append-only record. Evidence leaves the machine only when you send it.
This build carries the window, the console, the daemon, MCF's own engine and the reference engine, built from pinned sources. It provisions no engine of its own into a container.
First packaged build, for installing on other machines to try. Not published.
